name: Heavy-Load Snapshot & Handoff Hardening
changes: Removes cross-process ledger file reads, JSON decoding and state merges from Downloads snapshot rendering; the 25 ms presentation budget now covers only bounded access to the already-synchronized in-memory ledger while strict background workers retain authoritative disk reconciliation.

Moves live engine-status probing/identity reads to the background engine coordinator and makes Downloads snapshots consume cached engine health, eliminating another heavy-load localhost/disk hotspot from the foreground request path.

Splits card/collection/statistics projection into its own snapshot timing phase so the former catch-all other phase is actionable under load, while retaining p50/p90/p95/p99 and worst-build attribution.

Adds a four-second newly-submitted SAB handoff grace: live SAB jobs are still surfaced immediately, but a normal submit-to-ledger race no longer emits a false missing-ledger warning or consistency mismatch unless ownership remains missing beyond the grace window.
Changes multiple-active-slot correction telemetry from per-poll inflation to distinct overlap episodes, while separately counting observed overlap samples and duration.
Corrects legacy downloads.json compaction telemetry so an already-compacted no-op reports the real current file size instead of incorrectly reporting zero bytes after compaction.

Preserves the v3.6.50 Queue/History sampler, deferred persistence, installer cleanup and Automation candidate aging; v3.6.49 bounded Downloads data plane, strict Smart Import ownership, Library Integrity protections, Selected Episodes/PAR2 visibility and private SABnzbd 5.1.2 remain intact.
regression_guards: All established automation identity, Library Integrity, quality, Selected Episodes, PAR2/repair, v3.6.49 data-plane and v3.6.50 sampler/state-lock regressions remain mandatory.

v3.6.51 structurally forbids _refresh_shared_state_for_snapshot from reading the ledger file, entering the cross-process ledger guard or merging shared states; a held local lock must still return within the bounded presentation budget.
Snapshot rendering must use engine_status_cached while the background engine loop refreshes the full engine-status cache.
Synthetic handoff tests require a newly surfaced SAB slot to stay warning-free during the four-second ownership grace and require a persistent orphan to emit at most one warning after grace.
Multiple-active telemetry tests require repeated samples of one overlap condition to count as one correction episode until the condition clears.
Legacy compaction no-op tests require bytes_after to equal the actual unchanged legacy file size.
The release workflow runs the carried-forward v3.6.50 guard and the new v3.6.51 regression guard before any Windows release assets are built.
